units.title: Pointer tags, NaN payloads and representation trust boundaries â€” derivation and construction
steps: Derive disjoint number and integer bit partitions, pointer round-trip preconditions and negative decoding; classify portable arithmetic, implementation-defined pointer mapping and explicit IEEE-format assumptions.

Implement numeric NaN canonicalization, int32 boxing/unboxing and checked two-bit pointer tags from the exact contract. Build a discriminated-union alternative and a character-copy double bridge with verified format assumptions; never truncate a pointer into a payload.

steps: Explain canonical identity versus byte equality, table ownership, embedded-NUL handling and why collisions cannot prove equality. Distinguish strong intern retention from weak symbol tables.

Implement the eight-entry copied-string table with first-insertion IDs and atomic admission failure, then implement a hashed table with explicit collision chains or probing and transactional resizing; compare both on the same byte-string contract.

Reject length-only equality and ignored-admission-failure mutants; use a Python dictionary as an independent identity oracle.
